release_notes: Cloaking now uses separate IP2Proxy LITE PX12, IP2Location ASN LITE and MaxMind GeoLite2-ASN data for proxy, VPN, Tor, datacenter, threat, fraud-score and network detection. Geo database uploads validate each provider format and no longer confuse PX12 with DB11. Apache campaign aliases work directly at /campaign-alias. Existing Git installations can update from the admin panel; Composer dependencies are installed automatically, unfinished Git conflicts are repaired, and the manual fallback instructions now include the complete safe update command.
